clue.text: Rub along, even becoming difficult

indicators.note: the letters of the first three words turn into, or become, a new word

explanation.surface: Getting along with someone, even in a rubbing-along way, turns into hard work.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hard to control or manage is difficult, a near synonym.

clue.text: Turned vase with nude almost lost

indicators.note: the letters are turned over and around into a new order
almost the whole word, so its final letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A vase spun round beside a nude figure that is nearly mislaid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts NUDE to NUD; 'Turned' rearranges VASE plus NUD.
explanation.definitionFit: In the religious sense, a soul not saved from damnation is lost.

clue.text: Greatest of all time secures large triumph

indicators.note: holds firmly inside, so one piece is enclosed by the other

parts.note: the acronym GOAT stands for greatest of all time
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A sporting legend locks up a big victory.
explanation.definitionFit: To exult smugly over a win is to triumph, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Sweetheart proud about fast time with sweetheart

indicators.note: placed round, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: vain means proud, conceited
Lent is the Christian season of fasting
the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter E

explanation.surface: A conceited lover dates a sweetheart during a period of fasting.
explanation.definitionFit: A Valentine is the person you choose as your love, a sweetheart.

clue.text: Madness of King over time

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over, above, the second

parts.note: R, from Latin rex, abbreviates king
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A monarch's insanity lasting a long time, like King George III.
explanation.definitionFit: Fury or wild frenzy is madness, in the sense of being mad with anger.

clue.text: Turn on United supporter as it happens

parts.note: a turn on stage is an act
U abbreviates United, as in football club names
an ally is a supporter

explanation.surface: Someone attacks a fan of United football club, so it turns out.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases mean in fact or in reality, an idiomatic synonym.

clue.text: Car plant

definitions.meaning: a British make of sports car
a water lily of Asia and Egypt

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to a British sports-car marque and to a sacred water lily.

clue.text: Reinforced resistance in French love of revolutionary

indicators.note: put inside the following word

parts.note: amour is French for love
R is the physics symbol for electrical resistance

indicators.note: turning round, revolving, reads the word backwards

parts.note: de is French for of, carrying on the French theme

explanation.surface: The French Resistance and a love affair with a revolutionary, in wartime romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Plated with protective armour means reinforced against attack.

clue.text: Behind on the wagon in crash

indicators.note: placed inside the other word

parts.note: a boom is a loud crash
TT, teetotal, means abstaining from alcohol

explanation.surface: Someone who has quit drinking falls on their behind in a crash.
explanation.definitionFit: Behind is a colloquial word for the buttocks, a synonym.

clue.text: Stress is negligible taking cannabis

indicators.note: takes in, so one word holds the other

parts.note: slight means negligible, very small
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: Stress becomes trivial once you smoke some weed.
explanation.definitionFit: To highlight or emphasise something is to stress it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Trunk ultimately cut roughly

indicators.note: at the very end, so the last letter of cut

parts.note: or so means roughly, approximately

explanation.surface: A tree trunk eventually sawn up crudely.
explanation.definitionFit: The trunk of the body, without head or limbs, is a synonym.

clue.text: Very old can start to guide election

parts.note: a tin is a can

indicators.note: the start of the word guide, its first letter

explanation.surface: An ancient container leads the way in an election.
explanation.definitionFit: Casting ballots is the process of an election.

clue.text: Permit secretary's physical activity

parts.note: a PA, personal assistant, is a secretary; with the possessive S
sport is physical activity

explanation.surface: A secretary's exercise class needs official permission.
explanation.definitionFit: A travel document is a permit allowing entry to other countries.

clue.text: Perhaps make short detectives dig endlessly?

parts.note: DIs are detective inspectors

indicators.note: without its end, so the final letter goes

parts.note: to till is to dig the soil

explanation.surface: Wondering whether police officers might cut short their endless digging.
explanation.walkthrough: A short is a measure of spirits, so to make a short is to produce spirits; 'Perhaps' marks this as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirits are produced by heating and condensing liquor; a short is a small measure of spirit.

clue.text: Liverish, and I eschew swallowing drinks

indicators.note: the words take in, swallow, the answer within their letters

explanation.surface: Feeling queasy, someone refuses to swallow anything.
explanation.definitionFit: Beer mixed with lemonade gives these drinks, popular in British pubs.

clue.text: Pick fruit with each tart oddly filling

indicators.note: the letters fill the fruit, going inside it

parts.note: a plum is a fruit

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters of the two words

explanation.surface: Selecting fruit, each tart with an odd filling.
explanation.definitionFit: A guitar pick, used to pluck the strings, is a synonym.

clue.text: Joke about uniform on Parisian street upset driver

indicators.note: placed round, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: chaff is light-hearted banter, joking
U is uniform in the NATO alphabet

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: rue is French for street

explanation.surface: A joke about a uniformed driver upset on a Paris street.
explanation.definitionFit: A person employed to drive someone's car is a driver.

clue.text: Knife fight pinching cash box, practically

indicators.note: pinching holds tightly inside

parts.note: a set-to is a fight

indicators.note: practically all of it, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a till is a cash box

explanation.surface: A knife fight breaks out as someone nearly steals the cash box.
explanation.definitionFit: A slim dagger is a type of knife.

clue.text: Artist raves, typically about caricature

indicators.note: here around, the outer words lie about the answer within them

explanation.surface: An artist characteristically rants about cartoon portraits.
explanation.definitionFit: A grotesque parody or distorted imitation is a caricature.

clue.text: Put forward awkward truths

indicators.note: awkwardly arranged, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Uncomfortable facts are offered up.
explanation.definitionFit: To push or shove something forcibly is to put it forward.

clue.text: Sacked left-winger receiving support

indicators.note: taking in, so one word holds the other

parts.note: a red is a socialist or communist
aid is support

explanation.surface: A sacked leftist gets benefits.
explanation.definitionFit: A plundered town has been sacked, so attacked and raided.

clue.text: Insanely angered, leading to anger

definitions.note: describes the act of driving someone mad, the verb's sense

indicators.note: madly, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone furious beyond reason, which only provokes more fury.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: to drive someone mad provokes rage.
explanation.definitionFit: To unhinge someone, making them mad, can provoke fury.

clue.text: Intensify and be louder in a frenzy

indicators.note: wildly agitated, so the letters are tossed around

explanation.surface: Turn it up and shout louder in a wild frenzy.
explanation.walkthrough: Only BE LOUDER is shuffled; 'and' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To double again, increase greatly, is to intensify.

clue.text: Beeb, lacking leader, is free

indicators.note: lacking its leader means the word loses the letter that leads it, its first

parts.note: Beeb and Auntie are both nicknames for the BBC, Britain's public broadcaster

explanation.surface: The BBC, headless, is free of charge.
explanation.walkthrough: Auntie is an affectionate nickname for the BBC; the BBC is funded by a licence fee, hence the joke on free.
explanation.definitionFit: To undo a knot or unfasten is to free, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Female consumed by a fine romance

indicators.note: eaten up, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: fair weather is fine

explanation.surface: A woman swept up in a lovely love story.
explanation.definitionFit: A love affair is a romantic liaison, a romance.

clue.text: Male embraced by a male? Capital!

indicators.note: held in the arms, so the letter is enclosed

parts.note: a man is a male

explanation.surface: A man hugged by another man, greeted with a cheer of approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital!' looks like an exclamation of approval; it is a nation's chief city.
explanation.definitionFit: The city is the capital of Jordan.

clue.text: Starts to gossip and blather senselessly

definitions.text: Starts to gossip and blather senselessly

indicators.note: the starts of the four following words, their first letters

explanation.surface: Someone launches into gossip and mindless chatter.
explanation.definitionFit: To chatter idly and at length is to talk nonsense, as the whole clue describes.

clue.text: Bouquet thrown outside front of church

indicators.note: goes outside, wrapping the letter

parts.note: sent, as when a ball is sent or thrown

indicators.note: the front of the word church, its first letter

explanation.surface: A wedding bouquet tossed in front of the church.
explanation.definitionFit: The bouquet of a wine is its aroma or smell.

clue.text: Designated facility rejected housing small retailer?

indicators.note: giving a home to, so the letter goes inside
thrown back, so the two words are read backwards

parts.note: named means designated
art is facility, skill

explanation.surface: A designated shop unit turned down for a small trader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns NAMED ART into TRADEMAN; the question mark shows a shopkeeper is one kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A shopkeeper or skilled worker in trade; a retailer is one example.

clue.text: Performing 'Carmen', tenor's showing grievance

indicators.note: performing a piece reworks it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tenor singing in the opera Carmen airs a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal protest or complaint states a grievance.
